new_claims.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate product banks with exact physical cross rank r>=3, nonzero cross singular values sigma_j and arbitrary measurable same-bank terms, the output has a continuous C0 density with ||p||inf <= 2r/(r-2) (prod sigma_j)^(-1/r). More generally with projected density caps M_X,M_Y the coefficient is r/(r-2)(M_XM_Y)^(1/r).

If an h-row hub leaves at most eta of E3 outside and a heavy exact hub-intersection pattern has retained cross rank exactly three, then ||p||inf <= 6[(2^h-1)/(1-eta)]^(1/6) E3(M)^(-1/6), with continuity. At h<=6, eta=1/16 the coefficient is 12.097978152622812.

peer_result_applied.application: Its product-marginal density input is applied at the L2 inequality: ||rho_{U^T X}||inf,||rho_{V^T Y}||inf<=2^(r/2), hence the complex pushforward densities have L2 norms <=2^(r/4).

unresolved_implication: QFORM-FINITE-COMPOUND-HUB-HIGHER-RANK-v1: pay determinant-volume-heavy retained hub patterns of physical cross rank >=4 without paying arbitrarily small fourth-and-higher singular values.
